research_notes: 2026-10-01 avenues: frozen roster (empty occupations), ALP and MP biographies, first speech, explicit 2026 workplace speech and ABC 2022 guide. Public LinkedIn open returned (999) Unknown Status Code; no bypass attempted.

Identify pub and electrical employers/entities, dates, hours, leave and job changes. Resolve degree/trade sequence discrepancy between ABC 2022 and current first-person summary; obtain university/admission records. Separate employment hours from study and campaign periods.

Obtain ETU and UPFU role titles, appointment/cessation dates and employment conditions from union annual reports/staff archives; check whether any private legal-practice employer exists. Do not treat all legal work as private sector.

Namesake exclusions: MinterEllison Perth partner, US McKinsey executive and Lake Forest Park mayor named Tom French were not matched to this MP and were not used. Broad teaching search produced unrelated people and no evidence of teaching employment.
